title: One step equals one-step iteration
statement: For every Boolean input word $x$ and every configuration of the transducer on $x$, running the machine for one step gives the same configuration as applying its one-step transition.
hypotheses_covered: arbitrary configuration of the transducer on $x$
replaced:
Running the clause-splitting transducer for exactly one step from any
configuration coincides with applying its single-step transition.
